description: This file defines a fake HTTP handler for testing purposes within the Kubernetes client-go testing utilities. It includes the FakeHandler struct, interfaces for logging and testing, and methods to simulate HTTP request handling and validation.

classes.name: FakeHandler
classes.description: A mock HTTP handler for testing HTTP requests, capable of recording requests, setting responses, and validating request properties.

methods.name: SetResponseBody
methods.description: Sets the response body that the FakeHandler will return.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests, records request data, and returns the configured response.

methods.name: ValidateRequestCount
methods.description: Validates that the handler received the expected number of requests.

methods.name: ValidateRequest
methods.description: Validates that the received request matches expected path, method, and body.
